name: Titus
bio: Titus, Paul's close companion and partner in ministry, was sent by Paul to Corinth, and Paul's anxious wait for news of him in Macedonia turned to joy when Titus arrived with a comforting report of the church's response; Titus also helped organize the collection for the Jerusalem believers and was praised by Paul as earnest and genuine in his care for the Corinthians (2 Corinthians 2:13, 7:6-14, 8:6-23, 12:18). His further role is told in the Epistle to Titus. Fourteen years after Paul's conversion, Titus accompanied him and Barnabas to Jerusalem; though Titus was a Greek, the apostles there did not require him to be circumcised (Galatians 2:1-3).
